_comment: The passport for a STANDARD change. Ownership is named and resolvable exactly as it always is — a pattern re-prices the APPROVAL, never the accountability. `pa1.decision` and `pa2.decision` stay `pending` on purpose: the decision was not taken on this change, it was taken on the pattern, and writing `approved` here would be a claim nobody made. scripts/change-envelope-check.mjs is what reads the pattern and satisfies the state receipts; the record of who approved WHAT is the pattern's own `approved_by` and `expires`.

pa1._comment: Covered by pre-approved pattern `dependency-patch` (profiles/regulated-bank.json), approved by risk-lena, expiring, sampled at 10%.

pa2._comment: Same pattern. If the pattern expires or the claim stops matching, this change owes both stages in full — and the gate says so on the next run.
